title: HTML & CSS Web Development Mastery
description: Build complete, accessible, responsive web pages from HTML and CSS fundamentals through Flexbox/Grid, frameworks, browser internals, and enough JavaScript/HTTP knowledge to bridge into full-stack development.

nodes.label: Web Fundamentals Orientation
nodes.description: Understand the distinct responsibilities of HTML (structure/meaning), CSS (presentation/layout), and JavaScript (behavior) as the three layers of a web page, and how they combine in the browser.
